Raw ecrecover() with no s-value bound: a function recovers a signer with ecrecover() and never checks that s is in the lower half of the curve order, so the malleable twin (s -> n - s) recovers the same signer and one authorization counts as two distinct signatures - the SWC-117 shape. OpenZeppelin ECDSA (ECDSA.recover / tryRecover) or an explicit require(s <= n/2) guard is the protected shape. Observed: 'permit' calls raw ecrecover() with no s <= n/2 guard and no OpenZeppelin ECDSA in the contract, so the malleable twin signature (s -> n - s) recovers the same signer. Gate analysis: no caller

A fee-on-transfer, rebasing-down or otherwise short-delivering token is credited at face value, and the credited position redeems against the full pool - the shortfall is taken from the other depositors. Observed: 'deposit' pulls 'amount' with transferFrom and credits it at face value (_mint credit to recipient) with no balanceOf delta measurement anywhere in the function. Gate
